concerns.text: The plan mandates Wilcoxon signed‑rank tests on F1‑scores across only 5 random seeds and then applies a Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR < 0.05 threshold (SC‑003). With n = 5 paired observations the smallest attainable two‑sided p‑value is ≈0.0625, so no comparison can ever achieve the declared significance level after BH correction. This makes the significance claim empirically impossible, rendering the validation circularly dependent on an unattainable outcome and violating the scientific requirement that the hypothesis test be feasible. The methodology must be revised (e.g., increase the number of seeds/replicates or relax the FDR threshold) to allow a non‑trivial test of significance.
